name: Eclair "Super Hero" Masks with Vanilla Pastry Cream Filling

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE ECLAIR SHELLS: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with parchment paper.
Cut butter into small pieces. Place in a medium saucepan along with milk, sugar, and salt. Set over medium-high and heat, stirring occasionally, until butter is completely melted, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
½ cup whole milk
1 tbsp granulated sugar
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the butter is melted, add flour to the pan. Cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture forms a dough that coats the bottom of the pan, 2 minutes more.
When the dough is done, transfer to the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Mix on medium until the dough has cooled and the sides of the bowl are warm to the touch, 3-5 minutes.

Add eggs, one at a time, waiting for each egg to incorporate into the dough before adding the next one. Stop the mixer, scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula, then continue to mix until the dough is glossy and completely combined, 2-3 minutes more.
Transfer dough to a piping bag fitted with a large plain circle tip. Pipe 2-inch wide by 4-inch long logs onto the prepared baking sheets, spacing them 2-inches apart.

Place baking sheets in the oven and bake for 15 minutes. Without opening the oven, reduce the temperature to 350°F and continue to bake until the pastry shells are golden brown, 15-20 minutes more. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
FOR THE PASTRY CREAM: Working over a small bowl, separate egg yolks from whites, leaving whites in the bowl. Place yolks in a medium bowl and set aside. (Reserve egg whites for another use.)
Place butter in a clean medium saucepan along with milk, vanilla, and salt. Set over medium-high and heat, stirring occasionally, until butter is completely melted, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
whole milk
2 tsp vanilla extract
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, add sugar and cornstarch to the bowl with the egg yolks. Whisk until yolks are pale and fluffy, 2-3 minutes.

When the butter is melted, gradually add half of the hot milk mixture to the bowl with the egg mixture, whisking constantly. Pour the yolk mixture back into the pan with the remaining milk and whisk to combine.

Return pan to medium heat. Continue to cook, whisking constantly, until pastry cream thickens, 3-4 minutes more. Pour thickened pastry cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean medium bowl. Cover pastry cream with plastic film (allow the plastic to sit on top of the cream), then place in the fridge to cool completely, about 1 hour.
FOR THE MILK GLAZE: Place milk and powdered sugar in another small bowl. Whisk to combine the milk glaze and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
whole milk
1 ½ cups powdered sugar

instructions.primary_message: ECLAIR ASSEMBLY AND DECORATING: When the shells have cooled, halve them lengthwise, then separate the tops and bottoms between the baking sheets.
Using a pastry brush, coat the tops of the shells with milk glaze. Set aside to dry, about 20 minutes.
Remove pastry cream from fridge and stir to loosen. Divide the cream between the shell bottoms, spreading it out in an even layer.
Close filled eclairs with the glazed tops, then decorate with colored icing in the shape of masks. For best results, allow mask shapes to dry before adding more decorations, about 20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (77 g) pkg decorating icing, assorted colors

instructions.primary_message: Arrange eclairs on a serving platter and enjoy!
